reading.requirement: Current exact source SHA and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Question evidence uses spoken transcript spans only. Canonical source usage, official paired Conversation audio, rights and alignment gates remain required. No actual independent audio listen was performed during question authoring.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same-source text/audio share one group. These public practice candidates are not independent assessment or unseen-transfer evidence.

questions.prompt: Why does Anna check the forecast every day?
options: The weather is always the same.
She is planning a trip to Mexico.
questions.evidence: Here in Washington, DC, the weather changes often. One day is cold and windy. But the next day is warm and sunny! So, every day I check the forecast.
questions.explanation: Anna先说明天气经常变化，再用So引出每天查预报，原因是天气多变。always the same与原文相反；Mexico在后面是手机查错城市的线索，没有说Anna计划去那里旅行。

spokenEvidence.quote: Here in Washington, DC, the weather changes often. One day is cold and windy. But the next day is warm and sunny! So, every day I check the forecast.

questions.prompt: What unit does the phone use for temperature?
questions.explanation: 手机补充说eighteen degrees Celsius，明确使用摄氏温标，因此填Celsius。Fahrenheit是Anna随后换算时提到的温标，不能把她的换算单位当成手机最初采用的单位。

questions.prompt: What Fahrenheit temperature does Anna give?
questions.evidence: That is 65 degrees Fahrenheit. That’s warm.
questions.explanation: Anna原话是65 degrees Fahrenheit，所以填65。18是手机给出的摄氏读数，不能把两个温标中的数字混在一起；本题只读取原话，不要求自己进行换算。

spokenEvidence.quote: That is 65 degrees Fahrenheit. That’s warm.

questions.prompt: What weather does Anna report after the phone’s forecast?
questions.evidence: It is not warm and sunny! It is cold and windy and snowy!
questions.explanation: Anna指出实际并非warm and sunny，而是cold、windy、snowy三个特点。温暖晴朗来自手机先前的预报；第三项虽然包含cold，但sunny和dry与她说的windy、snowy不一致。

spokenEvidence.quote: It is not warm and sunny! It is cold and windy and snowy!

questions.prompt: Which city is the phone’s warm and sunny forecast for?
questions.evidence: It is warm and sunny … in Mexico City, Mexico.
questions.explanation: 手机最后补充in Mexico City, Mexico，说明温暖晴朗的预报查的是墨西哥城。Washington是Anna当前所在的城市，并不是手机这次报出的地点；New York City没有出现在这次预报里。这一地点差异解释了前后天气不符。

spokenEvidence.quote: It is warm and sunny … in Mexico City, Mexico.

blindComparison.scope: Independent source-text blind solve before seeing keys. VOA12 then received an explicitly recorded punctuation-only source correction; all question facts and answers were rechecked unchanged.
